desc:
📜 SCROLLS OPEN AND GENERATE MONEY WHILE YOU'RE OFFLINE! 🤑

🎁 Use code "BUGFIXES" in the shop for rewards to get started! Join the community for even more codes!

⛩️ How to play:
📜 COLLECT SCROLLS — Discover rare scrolls and unlock powerful ninjas!
⚔️ BATTLE ENEMIES — Take your strongest ninjas into battle, defeat waves of bandits, and challenge powerful bosses!
💰 EARN CASH — Build your ninja empire and generate massive amounts of Cash!
✨ DISCOVER RARITIES — Collect increasingly rare ninjas with unique appearances and powerful auras!
🏯 PROGRESS & CONQUER — Unlock new zones, strengthen your collection, and rise to the top!

🔥 Can you collect the rarest ninjas and build the ultimate shinobi empire?

⭐  LIKE the game and join the group for more updates!
